title: Brand-abuse pages behind JavaScript apps (P304 cond 12)
notes: P304 (batch p2-G14-3): pages that curl cannot verify (SPA or anti-bot). V3LUM never requests these URLs, not even from doctor, and never solves their challenges (P304 cond 1). verified stays false until a team member opens the link in a browser: then verified=true, checked_at=<date>, x_verification='browser', x_checked_by=<name> and the label marker '(browser)' (P304 cond 6); 'curl' never appears here. x_module_links are rendered by the module pivots_unverified (module-side placeholders url_sha256, url_path, cve_num, hunter_q, and the per-link x_max_tlp the frozen schema lacks).
